sources.title: Batch 0053 exact Java min-heap source context

claims.text: The preserved source asks for a Java min-heap implementation without directly using PriorityQueue; it does not preserve a fixed API, capacity limit, empty-heap behavior, duplicate policy, or concurrency contract.
The candidate explicitly chooses an int-backed dynamic array, allows duplicate values, supports add/peek/poll/size/isEmpty, and throws NoSuchElementException for empty peek/poll.
Array-indexed complete-tree storage plus sift-up after append and sift-down toward the smaller child after root replacement restores the min-heap parent<=child invariant along one root-to-leaf path.

Executable validation covers empty behavior, duplicates, signed integer extremes, 50000 deterministic mixed operations against an independent TreeMap multiset oracle, and a 200000-element drain against a separately sorted array oracle.
